identificationModule.briefTitle: Salvage Radiotherapy Combined With Androgen Deprivation Therapy (ADT) With or Without Rezvilutamide in the Treatment of Biochemical Recurrence After Radical Prostatectomy for Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Salvage Radiotherapy Combined With Androgen Deprivation Therapy (ADT) With or Without Rezvilutamide in the Treatment of Biochemical Recurrence After Radical Prostatectomy for Prostate Cancer: a Prospective, Multicenter, Randomized Controlled Clinical Study

leadSponsor.name: The Affiliated Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of rezvilutamide in combination with androgen deprivation therapy(ADT) and standard salvage radiation therapy(SRT) or SRT combination with ADT in prostate cancer patients with biochemical recurrence of prostate-specific antigen(PSA) persistence after radical prostatectomy(RP).

armGroups.label: Rezvilutamide +ADT+ SRT
armGroups.description: Rezvilutamide along with ADT for 6 cycles (28 days for each cycle) in combination with salvage radiation therapy (SRT) according to standard of care

armGroups.label: ADT+ SRT
armGroups.description: ADT for 6 cycles (28 days for each cycle) in combination with salvage radiation therapy (SRT) according to standard of care

interventions.name: Rezvilutamide
interventions.description: Specifications of 80 mg; orally, once a day

interventions.name: Androgen deprivation therapy (ADT)
interventions.description: Androgen deprivation therapy (ADT), the ADT used by each subject will be determined by the investigator,and the dose and frequency of administration will be consistent with the prescription information

interventions.name: SRT
interventions.description: SRT according to standard of care (66.6-72 grays will be delivered to the bed of prostate ,\~50.4 grays to the pelvis if needed)

primaryOutcomes.description: biochemical progression is defined as a confirmed prostate specific antigen (PSA) greater than (\>) 0.2 nanogram per milliliter (ng/ml) ( the time interval should be over 2 weeks)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Time from entry to biochemical progression or radiologically confirmed progressive disease or death due to any cause
Time from entry to radiologically confirmed metastasis disease or death due to any cause.
percentage of undetectable PSA is defined as the proportion of subjects with a PSA level ≤ 0.1 ng/mL after enrollment
ctDNA-positive rate was defined as the number of ctDNA subjects detected in the total enrolled population
Defined as the number of patients who were ctDNA-positive at enrollment to ctDNA-negative after treatment as a proportion of ctDNA-positive patients enrolled
